For Petitioner : Mr. Ramcharan Sahu, Advocate on behalf of Mr. Surfaraj Khan, Advocate.
For Respondents : Mr. Ghanshyam Pate, Advocate.
Hon'ble Shri Justice Sanjay Kumar Jaiswal Order on Board 10.05.2024

1 .  The petitioner has filed the present contempt petition under Section 12 of the Contempt of Court Act, 1971 read with Article 215 of the Constitution of India alleging non-compliance of the order dated 24.08.2021 (Annexure - C/1) passed by this Court in WPC No. 3439/2021.
2.

Learned counsel for the respondents would submit that the land has not been acquired by the State pursuant to the proposed Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:17180 notification, therefore, the contempt petition is not maintainable at this juncture.

The learned counsel for the respondent would further submit that he has filed the documents to demonstrate that the petitioner is still in possession of the land and he is utilizing the same for agriculture purpose and has sold the paddy to the Paddy Procurement Centre.

Kisun vs Neelam Namdev Ekka on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26532835/
1 3.

Considering the factual matrix of the case, the contempt is disposed of, however, liberty is granted to the petitioner if the respondent acquires the land which is permissible under Land Acquisition Law and compensation is not paid to the petitioner, he will be at liberty to file a fresh petition or contempt proceedings or any other remedy available to him.
4. With this observation, this contempt petition is disposed of with the aforesaid liberty granted in favour of the petitioner.

Sd/-
(Sanjay Kumar Jaiswal) Judge Sourabh P.
